ModMetaData.name: Skiptech Pathing
ModMetaData.author: EvilEyeGuy
ModMetaData.description:
Local add-on for MigCorp - Skiptech. Skipdoor selection uses per-door distance fields, built in the background, instead of a region search and two trial path requests for every long trip. Leg paths are only requested when the estimated route through the doors beats the direct walk.
Adds a stone skipgate: built from any stone, no power, short opening delay. Research: stone skipgates (medieval, after stonecutting).
